declarations.name: ArcgisPlaneNavigationElement
declarations.description: Adds aircraft flight, camera controls, and optional UI to a caller-owned ArcGIS 3D scene or SceneView. Import the package once to register the element.

members.name: status
members.description: Current lifecycle state. Read-only; reflected to the `status` HTML attribute.

members.name: view
members.description: Caller-owned 3D SceneView. Takes precedence over scene-element references and is never destroyed by the component.

members.name: referenceElement
members.description: Caller-owned `<arcgis-scene>` element. Takes precedence over `reference-element`; an assigned `view` takes precedence over both.

members.name: config
members.description: Reading returns the complete normalized configuration. Assign a partial `PlaneNavigationConfigInput` to update it.

attributes.name: reference-element
attributes.description: ID of a caller-owned `<arcgis-scene>` in the same document. A directly assigned `view` or `referenceElement` property takes precedence.

attributes.name: start-longitude
attributes.description: Starting longitude in degrees. Supply together with `start-latitude`.

attributes.name: start-latitude
attributes.description: Starting latitude in degrees, from -90 to 90. Supply together with `start-longitude`.

attributes.name: start-altitude-m
attributes.description: Starting absolute altitude in metres. Omit to start above sampled terrain.

attributes.name: start-heading-deg
attributes.description: Starting heading in degrees clockwise from north.

attributes.name: start-speed-mps
attributes.description: Initial forward speed. Uses metres per second in local scenes and projected scene units per second in global Web Mercator scenes.

attributes.name: camera-mode
attributes.description: Initial camera view. Changes to this attribute update the active flight without restarting it.

attributes.name: power-mode
attributes.description: Initial flight power mode: brake toward slow speed, cruise normally, or use turbo boost.

attributes.name: sensitivity
attributes.description: Keyboard, gamepad, and touch control sensitivity, clamped to 0.5 through 2.

attributes.name: fov-deg
attributes.description: Base camera field of view in degrees, clamped to 58 through 76.

attributes.name: invert-pitch-disabled
attributes.description: Presence disables the default inverted pitch control. Remove the attribute to restore the default; `="false"` still counts as present.

attributes.name: camera-roll-disabled
attributes.description: Presence disables banked viewport roll during turns.

attributes.name: keyboard-disabled
attributes.description: Presence disables keyboard flight input.

attributes.name: gamepad-disabled
attributes.description: Presence disables gamepad flight input.

attributes.name: capture-scene-navigation-disabled
attributes.description: Presence leaves ArcGIS scene navigation gestures under the host's control.

attributes.name: auto-start-disabled
attributes.description: Presence initializes flight in the ready state; call `start()` to begin flying.

attributes.name: show-controls
attributes.description: Presence shows the built-in flight toolbar.

attributes.name: joystick
attributes.description: Touch joystick visibility. `auto` shows it on coarse-pointer devices, independently of the toolbar.

attributes.name: joystick-position
attributes.description: ArcGIS scene slot for the touch joystick; defaults to `bottom-left`.

attributes.name: ui-position
attributes.description: ArcGIS scene slot for the built-in toolbar; defaults to `bottom-end`.

attributes.name: ui-controls
attributes.description: Unique toolbar controls separated by spaces or commas: `power`, `pause`, `camera`, `recover`.

attributes.name: show-speed
attributes.description: Presence shows the speed readout in the built-in toolbar.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Language for built-in controls. `auto` follows ArcGIS, document, then browser language.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Read-only reflected lifecycle state; set by the component.

events.name: arcgisPlaneNavigationReady
events.description: Session initialized; detail contains the scene, view, and initial snapshot.

events.name: arcgisPlaneNavigationSnapshot
events.description: Flight state changed; detail contains the current snapshot.

events.name: arcgisPlaneNavigationError
events.description: Initialization or active scene failed; detail contains the Error.

events.name: arcgisPlaneNavigationStopped
events.description: Explicit stop completed; detail reports the camera restoration policy.
